correctness.rationale: Formal increasing-tree bivariate exponential generating functions satisfy T_0,z=y-1+exp(T_0) and T_h,z=exp(T_{h-1})-1. Differentiation in leaf marker proves A_h and B_h recurrences. Deficiency D_h=2B_h-zA_h′+(h-1)A_h has D_1=D_2=0 and D_h′=exp(A_{h-1})D_{h-1}+(h-2)(exp(A_{h-1})(1-A_{h-1})-1). The bracket is -sum_{k≥2}(k-1)A_{h-1}^k/k!, with nonpositive coefficients; A_{h-1} first has positive degree h and all later positive coefficients. The base h=3 first negative D_3 at degree seven; induction gives first negative D_h at degree h+4 and strict negativity thereafter. Positive denominator coefficients for n≥h+1 convert exact coefficient signs into the asserted conditional-mean signs. Independent exhaustive recursive-tree enumeration through n=9, plus exact rational coefficients through n=21 for h≤10, gave 531 successful assertions. Finite computation is corroboration only. No statement for n≤h, whose conditioning event is empty.

originality.rationale: The new claim is an all-integer sharp conditional mean deficit: exact equality for h≤2 and n≤h+3, strict negative deviation for h≥3 and every n≥h+4. Inspected Mahmoud–Ward full text concerns protected-vertex counts and root-protection marginal events, not the conditional total-leaf mean. Gołębiewski–Klimczak concerns protection-number marginals on accessible abstract only, with remaining full-text risk. Midence-Ordóñez supplies classical rank-one/derangement background but no depth-three or general-depth sign cutoff. Closest published mathematical records concern other tree leaf/depth covariances. Same object alone does not imply same theorem. No claim of exhaustive priority or independent certification.

value.rationale: Protection depth is a natural local robustness invariant for rooted trees, while total leaf number measures global branching. The result identifies a universal sharp depth/sample-size border, valid for all h≥3 and all n≥h+4, beyond the classical h≤2 cancellation. Its first negative coefficient mechanism explains structural failure of linear conditional-leaf heuristics and can motivate refined mixed root-protection/branching statistics. This is a complete motivated sign classification rather than an arbitrary finite census.
